Start URL: http://intranet.office.local:8300/
1. Click link "Legacy ERP".
2. On the Sign in - Legacy ERP page, type <user name> into field "User name".
3. Click button "Sign in".
4. Click link "Travel Request" in the "Requests" menu.
5. On the Travel Request page, type <destination city> into field "Destination city".
6. Click button "Pick from date".
7. In the calendar, click button ">" in the table row "< <month from the request> ".
8. In the calendar, click button <start day from the request> in the table row "1 2 3 4 5 6 7".
9. Click button "Pick to date".
10. In the calendar, click button ">" in the table row "< <month to the request> ".
11. In the calendar, click button <end day from the request> in the table row "6 7 8 9 10 11 12".
12. Select <purpose from the request> for "Purpose".
Click link "Submit".
